title: Nagata’s championship stand against Takayama
summary: Yuji Nagata wins the heavyweight title as New Japan struggles over its identity. Yoshihiro Takayama targets the new champion and eventually brings a second championship into their showdown.

chapters.title: Nagata wins, Takayama attacks
chapters.result: Nagata defeats Yasuda for the IWGP title; Takayama attacks afterward.
chapters.context: The title victory immediately acquires a new antagonist, setting the direction for Nagata’s championship campaign.

chapters.title: Takayama takes the IWGP championship
chapters.result: NWF champion Takayama defeats Nagata for the IWGP title.
chapters.context: The match ends Nagata’s long reign and puts both heavyweight championships in Takayama’s possession.
